actual: C-010 formal preflight emits candidate_ready when both approved families omit validation_start/validation_end and does not freeze an independent train-plus-validation semantic source identity. Both fresh-process grids then complete all 5184 fits, and the parent fails only when D6 builds validation series with validation_start must be ISO YYYY-MM-DD. A dates-only fix would fail next because BUG-907 correctly freezes the fit source to the train window, which contains no D6 validation observations. Formal review also found that the READY writer compares D6 semantic receipts to train-only hashes, so a valid independent semantic source would still be rejected at the final durable layer.
closure_requirements: Keep BUG JSON and GitHub Issue synchronized.
description: C-010 formal preflight emits candidate_ready when both approved families omit validation_start/validation_end. expected: Formal preflight must freeze the approved 2024-07-01..2025-03-31 validation window and an immutable train-plus-validation semantic source/manifest identity. Explicit window drift must fail before source loading; missing or drifted semantic identity must fail before the first child fit. Fresh children remain train-only, D5 remains validation-blind, and only the parent may reload the frozen semantic source for D6. READY validation must preserve and independently verify the train lineage and semantic-validation lineage. No failure may write model/READY, database, or runtime state.
non_goals: Do not restart production runtime services without explicit approval.
